name: agentfinder
description: Independent reviews, editorial scores and comparisons for 1,000+ AI software tools, from agent-finder.co.

interface.longDescription:
AgentFinder helps you choose AI software. Ask whether an AI tool is worth using, which tool fits a job, or how two tools compare, and get answers from AgentFinder's library of more than 1,000 independent, published reviews: an editorial score out of 10, a short verdict, pricing, who the tool is best for, its pros and cons, and when the review was last updated.

What you can ask
• "Is this AI tool any good?" gets our review card for that tool.
• "What's the best AI tool for planning family meals?" gets up to five reviewed tools for that job, ranked by relevance and editorial score, with a shortlist link and a related buying guide when we have one.
• "Which of these two AI tools should I use?" gets a side-by-side comparison of score, pricing, free plan and best fit, plus our recommendation.

Honest by design
• Results are ranked only by relevance and our editorial score. There is no paid placement and no advertising.
• If we haven't reviewed a tool, the plugin says so instead of guessing, and suggests the closest tools we have reviewed.
• Every result links to the full review on agent-finder.co and shows when it was last updated.
• AgentFinder may earn a commission when you buy through links on agent-finder.co. It never affects scores or rankings.

About AgentFinder
AgentFinder (agent-finder.co) is an independent review site for AI software used in coding, writing, sales, productivity, finance, education and family life. Reviews are based on vendor documentation, published pricing and real user reports, with hands-on testing where it counts. Our methodology is published at agent-finder.co/about/methodology.

Privacy
The plugin is read-only and needs no account. It receives only the tool names, job description and filters in a request, never your name, email address or chat history. Details: agent-finder.co/privacy-policy.

positive.description: Review of a named AI tool
positive.expected_behavior: Shows AgentFinder's review card for Tsenta: score 7/10 (Good), verdict, pricing, best for, pros and cons, last-updated date and a Read full review link to agent-finder.co.

positive.prompt: What's the best AI family calendar organizer?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to five reviewed family calendar tools ranked by relevance and editorial score, the first marked Top pick, each with score and best-for, plus a shortlist link and the related buying guide.

positive.prompt: Cursor vs Windsurf - which should I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a side-by-side table of Cursor and Windsurf (score, pricing, free plan, best for, last updated), Cursor marked Our pick, our call, and a See full comparison link.

positive.prompt: Is there an AI tool that can transcribe music into sheet music?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows reviewed music transcription tools such as Klangio and AnthemScore, ranked, each with score and a link to its review.
Shows a Not reviewed by AgentFinder yet card and invents no score or verdict.
